feeds.description: Social Media Mom Juggling kids, home, brand, homeschooling, frugal living, and life's adventures.

feeds.title: Bitz & Giggles
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sara. I'm a full-time marketing professional, wife and mom to two wonderful children, not to mention Pinterest addict and lover of the outdoors. My family and I reside in the Midwest and although the winters can be long and harsh at times, I enjoy all of the seasons and appreciate what each one has to offer. My blog covers little 'bitz' of everything. This is the place I come to inspire others and be inspired - bringing the best of the best ideas, tips, recipes and more right to you!

feeds.title: Mommy Bunch
feeds.description: I'm Jesica, and I'm a mom to four kids ranging from four to twelve years old! I love to travel, cook, binge watch TV, read, and I'm a huge thrill junkie!

feeds.title: Wisconsin Mommy
feeds.description: Maureen Fitzgerald is a Milwaukee, Wisconsin influencer, brand enthusiast, and strategist. Wisconsin Mommy is a friendly lifestyle blog in the Milwaukee area that shares parenting tips, reviews, travel, recipes as well as local events for Wisconsin parents.

feeds.title: Operation $40K
feeds.description: Mom of 9-year-old college student. CEO of Operation $40K, Social Media Influencer, Brand Ambassador, Published Author, TV personality. Subscribe to this blog and receive notifications of new posts by email.

feeds.title: Parenthood Bliss
feeds.description: Parenthoodbliss, your leading online platform works dedicatedly, providing expert guidance on everything parenting, pregnancy, and baby products. They focus on accurate information, first-hand reviews, and a supportive community. The platform empowers parents to make informed decisions, right from the trimester days to parenting. The recommendations ensure parents gain access to premium items, the best advice on baby health, products, and a community to connect with.

feeds.title: Nut Free Mom Blog
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Jamie. I am a Mom to two very fun and active kids. This blog was established shortly after my oldest had an anaphylactic reaction to nuts on a road trip. Nut-Free Mom Blog became a place for us to share recipes and tips with family, friends, and school. Helping families navigate the nut-free lifestyle without compromising on the FUN!

feeds.title: My Milwaukee Mommy
feeds.description: I am Ann, a busy mother of four beautiful, fun-loving, energetic children! I live in the Milwaukee area and love to save money! I was a teacher for five years in the Milwaukee Public Schools System before becoming a stay-at-home mom when I had my first child...my daughter! I truly enjoy paying it forward to you, my readers, with giveaways, special promotions, freebies and money saving tips, and family activities.
